parole.testo: Coined by Israeli politician David Remez, a calque of German Seemanschaft or calque of English seamanship, from יַמַּאי (yamáy, “a seaman”) + ־וּת (-ut, “-ness, -ity”), the first part from יָם (yam, “sea”) + ־ַאי (áy, “-ian, -eer”, denoting a profession or occupation.).
Calque of German Konzentrationslager, itself a calque of English concentration camp.
